verses.1: Why have we not been seen from the heights in times past? And why have their days never been known to anyone?
verses.2: Their crops were destroyed; they lost their fields, and they suffered greatly.
verses.3: The wicked will be punished; they will be destroyed.
verses.4: They traveled together, along the same path, to help the poor of the land.
verses.5: They also went out into the desert, with their flocks. They went there to find food for the young men.
verses.6: In the field at night, they will be cut down, and the wicked will be destroyed.
verses.7: Our days are wasted without joy, and there’s no hope in the morning.
verses.8: The mountains will be filled with water, and from the walls of their shelters, they will emerge in groups.
verses.9: They will take them from the heights of heaven, and they will steal them from the poor.
verses.10: They went without any food, and they were hungry.
verses.11: Among their stories, they will proclaim their ways and deeds.
verses.12: From the city of Methim, Yinaqo and souls of the dead will be raised. But Eloah will not place any prayers upon them.
verses.13: Many were in the darkness, and they did not know His ways. They also did not follow His instructions.
verses.14: In the day, he will rise to commit murder; he will kill the poor and the elderly. At night, he will become a thief.
verses.15: And the eyes that were blind, they tried to hide them, saying, “Do not let me see.” They covered their faces.
verses.16: They built houses in the darkness, but they did not know that it would be dark forever.
verses.17: For together in the morning, they will be able to see the shadows of things, just as they can recognize the shadows of objects.
verses.18: They will be cursed by the waters; their portion in the land will be cursed. They will not be able to turn around through the paths of the trees.
verses.19: They will also be deprived of their blessings from the days of Snowball’s sins.
verses.20: Let them be forgotten by mercy; let their pride be destroyed. They will never be remembered again. They will become like trees that have been cut down.
verses.21: A woman who is barren shall not bear children, and a man who is impotent shall not be able to procreate.
verses.22: And the warriors rose with their strength, but they did not believe in those living beings.
verses.23: He will be given peace and comfort, and his eyes will be focused on their path.
verses.24: They have wandered far away, and they are no longer there. Everything has been destroyed, and the land is in ruins.
verses.25: And if not, who will stop me from doing it, and who will prevent me from acting according to my desires?
